=== la and lla of an external symbol relocate both halves
        la      a0, ext
        lla     a1, ext
        la      a2, ext+4
        lla     a3, ext-8

=== la of a label in another section
        la      a0, value
        lla     a1, value+2
        .data
        .word   0
value:  .word   1

=== la of a label in the same section resolves
back:   nop
        la      a0, back
        lla     a1, ahead
        la      a2, 1f
1:
ahead:  ret

=== la of a plain number is li
        .equ    K, 0x12345
        la      a0, 0x1000
        lla     a1, K
        la      a2, -1

=== la of a symbol set to a label
        .set    alias, value+4
        la      a0, alias
        .data
value:  .dword  0

=== pairs in a data section
        .data
        .word   1
        lla     a0, ext
        la      a1, 2f
2:      .word   2

=== the pair label follows a branch that grew
        beqz    a0, far
        .space  300
far:    la      a0, ext
        lw      a1, ext

=== pairs with compression off
        .option norvc
        la      a0, ext
        lw      a1, ext
        .option rvc
        la      a2, ext

=== integer loads from a symbol
        lb      a0, ext
        lbu     a1, ext
        lh      a2, ext
        lhu     a3, ext
        lw      a4, ext
        lwu     a5, ext
        ld      s1, ext+16

=== integer stores to a symbol
        sb      a0, ext, t0
        sh      a1, ext, t1
        sw      a2, ext, t2
        sd      a3, ext+8, s1

=== floating-point loads and stores through a symbol
        flw     fa0, ext, t0
        fld     fa1, ext, t1
        fsw     fa2, ext, t2
        fsd     fa3, ext, a0

=== loads and stores of a local label
        lw      a0, near
        sd      a0, near, t0
        ld      a1, far
        fld     fa0, far, t2
near:   .dword  0
        .data
far:    .dword  0

=== lga goes through the GOT
        lga     a0, ext
        lga     a1, ext+8
        lga     a2, here
        lga     a3, 1f
here:   nop
1:      nop

=== lga of a label in another section
        lga     a0, value
        .data
value:  .dword  0

=== option pic sends la through the GOT
        la      a0, ext
        .option pic
        la      a1, ext
        la      a2, local
        lla     a3, ext
        la      a4, 0x800
        .option nopic
        la      a5, ext
local:  ret

=== option push and pop keep pic
        .option push
        .option pic
        .option push
        .option norvc
        la      a0, ext
        .option pop
        la      a1, ext
        .option pop
        la      a2, ext
        mv      a3, a4

=== call, tail and jump
        call    ext
        call    ext@plt
        tail    ext
        call    t0, ext
        jump    ext, t1

=== local call, tail and jump resolve
        call    target
        tail    target
        jump    target, t0
target: ret
        call    target
        jump    target, a5

=== call of a label in another section
        call    far
        tail    far
        .section .text.far,"ax",@progbits
far:    ret

=== pcrel_hi and pcrel_lo name the auipc label
foo:    auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(ext)
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(foo)
        ld      a1, %pcrel_lo(foo)(a0)
        sd      a1, %pcrel_lo(foo)(a0)

=== pcrel_lo of numeric labels
1:      auipc   a0, %pcrel_hi(ext)
        addi    a0, a0, %pcrel_lo(1b)
1:      auipc   a1, %pcrel_hi(value)
        lw      a1, %pcrel_lo(1b)(a1)
        sw      a1, %pcrel_lo(1b)(a1)
        .data
value:  .word   0

=== hi and lo stay absolute
        lui     a0, %hi(ext)
        addi    a0, a0, %lo(ext)
        lui     a1, %hi(value+4)
        sd      a2, %lo(value+4)(a1)
        .data
value:  .dword  0

=== data relocations
        .data
        .dword  ext
        .dword  ext+4
        .word   ext
        .dword  value
value:  .dword  0
=== references to symbols in their own section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  glob, hid, prot, intl, galias, func
        .hidden hid
        .protected prot
        .internal intl
        .weak   weak1, walias, whid
        .hidden whid
        .type   func, %function
        .hidden lhid
start:
        call loc
        call glob
        call weak1
        call hid
        call prot
        call intl
        call whid
        call lhid
        call func
        call late
        call lweak
        call lalias
        call lwalias
        call galias
        call walias
        j loc
        j glob
        j weak1
        j lalias
        j walias
        jal loc
        jal glob
        jal weak1
        jal lalias
        jal walias
        lla a0, loc
        lla a0, glob
        lla a0, weak1
        lla a0, lalias
        lla a0, galias
        nop
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
hid:    nop
prot:   nop
intl:   nop
whid:   nop
lhid:   nop
func:   nop
late:   nop
lweak:  nop
        .globl  late
        .weak   lweak
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc

=== references back to symbols in their own section
        .text
        .globl  glob
        .weak   weak1
loc:    nop
glob:   nop
weak1:  nop
        .set    lalias, glob
        call loc
        call glob
        call weak1
        call lalias
        j loc
        j glob
        j weak1
        jal loc
        jal glob
        jal weak1

=== references out of their section, by binding
        .text
        .globl  oglob
        .weak   oweak, uweak
        .set    oalias, oloc
        call oloc
        call oglob
        call oweak
        call oalias
        call ext
        call uweak
        nop
        .section .text.other,"ax"
oloc:   nop
oglob:  nop
oweak:  nop

=== data referring to symbols, by binding
        .data
        .globl  glob, galias, hid
        .weak   weak1, walias
        .weak   uweak
        .hidden hid
        .set    lalias, glob
        .set    lwalias, weak1
        .set    galias, loc
        .set    walias, loc
base:   .long   loc, glob, weak1, hid, lalias, lwalias, galias, walias, ext
        .long   loc - ., glob - ., weak1 - ., lalias - ., walias - .
        .long   glob - base, weak1 - base, base - weak1, lalias - base, walias - base
        .long   ext - ., uweak - .
loc:    .long   0
glob:   .long   0
weak1:  .long   0
hid:    .long   0

=== default section alignment
        .text
        .byte   1
        .data
        .byte   2
        .section .rodata
        .byte   3
        .bss
        .space  1
        .section .text.hot,"ax"
        .byte   4
        .section .data.rel,"aw"
        .byte   5
        .section .init,"ax"
        .byte   6
        .section custom,"a"
        .byte   7

=== differences the file cannot fold are relocation pairs
        .text
        .weak   uweak
base:   nop
        .long   ext - .
        .long   ext - base + 4
        .long   base - ext + 4
        .short  ext - base
        .byte   ext - base
        .long   other - base
        .long   uweak - base
        .quad   ext - base
        .data
other:  .long   base - other
